Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I Deep Mine?
Description: Experimental companion for Should I?. Run user-started, explicitly scoped native Market Board deep scans, keep a local snapshot cache, and publish fresh market snapshots to Should I? through Dalamud IPC. Nothing scans automatically when the plugin loads.
Punchline: Explicit deep Market Board scans for Should I?
Changelog: v0.2.1 testing release: neutral external market-data IPC contract.
